text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at that giant monitor 
lizard...! This Amazon really is a 
paradise for animals!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! And on top of that, there's heaps of 
wild beasts. You two, don't stray away 
from me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...As for why we found ourselves in the 
Amazon, the story begins several hours 
earlier.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Hishi Ama-san, you're training in 
your muse racewear today too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's the season for the Beauty Dream Cup, 
after all. I figured I shouldn't forget 
where I started!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's a wonderful racing racewear, isn't 
it? Even the Amazon Lily in my hair 
accessory seems delighted♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Do you understand? This is a flower I'm 
particularly fond of.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
A lily-like flower that blooms upriver 
along the Amazon-- It's a popular choice 
for wedding bouquets, isn't it?
choice_data_list:
You cherish it so much you'd make it into 
a hair accessory?

You cherish it so much you'd make it into 
a hair accessory?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Back when I lived in the States, I 
saw one for the first time on an Amazon 
River tour."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Like, *shwing*, or maybe *ba-bam*... 
Mmmgh...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's so frustrating! You really won't 
understand this feeling unless you see it 
for yourself!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She wanted to find the Amazon lily 
blooming deep in the jungle. To that end, 
she entered the virtual Amazon via the VR 
Umulator.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Amazon lilies thrive in bright shade 
shielded from direct sunlight. Around 
here, it would be--

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Hold on a sec, I think I hear 
something over there...
Grrr...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking over, an alligator was crouching 
in the distance! I was about to suggest 
leaving the area for Hishi Amazon and the 
others' safety, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hold on... Could it be that she's... 
injured her leg?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's true! There's even blood coming 
out... It looks so painful...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ……I can't just leave them be, can I?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I won't fall behind someone 
who doesn't even have the will to move. 
Trust me on this.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yo, you look like you're hurting. Lemme 
see, Big Sis Hishiama'll take care of ya.

text_block_list.name: Alligator
text_block_list.text: Grrr... Gaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's virtual reality, the 
sensation of pain is real. I nervously 
watch over them, ready to pull them out 
the moment there's any danger, when—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hmph, no use acting tough.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Like I could ever turn a blind eye to 
someone who's hurt. Don't underestimate 
Big Sis Hishi Ama...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not moving a single inch from here— 
until I've taken care of you, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, you understand now, do ya. Don't 
you move...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...All right! It's just first aid, but it 
oughta be a bit better now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The alligator, with a handkerchief tied 
around its leg, let out a single cry and 
vanished deep into the Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's incredible...! Facing a wild beast 
without flinching in the slightest!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, what's with that face! Look, I'm 
completely fine, right? Besides—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Take a look over there!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wah, it's an Amazon lily!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
To bloom so pristinely white even within a 
dense jungle... It truly is a graceful 
flower, isn't it?
choice_data_list: That flower's just like Hishi Amazon.
That flower's just like Hishi Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh, me?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right! Standing firm by one's 
convictions without flinching, even 
against ferocious beasts—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"She is just like an Amazon lily, blooming 
proudly without being tainted by 
anything."
choice_data_list: Yes, that gallant air suits you perfectly.
Yes, that gallant air suits you perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haha, listen to you talk!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I always thought that I'd like to bloom 
on the turf just like that, too."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
No matter how fierce the beast, never 
yielding an inch, blooming strong and 
resilient just like the Amazon Lily—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Wearing this racing attire, I wanna go 
one-on-one against the strongest guys out 
there!"
choice_data_list:
It's a really special racing outfit to 
you, isn't it?

That racing outfit is special to you, 
isn't it?

If danger ever comes to you, I'll fight by 
your side

If danger ever comes for you, I'll fight 
right by your side!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Wearing this racing attire, I wanna go 
one-on-one against the strongest guys out 
there!"
choice_data_list:
It's a really special racing outfit to 
you, isn't it?

That racing outfit is special to you, 
isn't it?

If danger ever comes to you, I'll fight by 
your side

If danger ever comes for you, I'll fight

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! So, I won't run 
half-heartedly."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I have to run in a way that keeps this 
racing dress shining forever!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, that's reassuring!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still, don't do anything reckless. It'd be 
awful if you got hurt, Trainy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... If it's Hishi Ama-san, I feel like 
she'd bravely protect me no matter what 
happens♪
